item.title: Xeryon-Rotator v1.1.0.15
item.description:
Product: Xeryon-Rotator v1.1.0.15
Company: Levylab
Release Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 16:21:33 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: instrument framework smo for controlling xeryon rotation stage. initializes communication, monitors rotator status, logs status, and exposed api to for other labview vis to set and get the angle

Release Notes: Fixed
- Reworked serial communication so the driver reads the entire buffer instead of one line per call. Fixes the unbounded Bytes at Port growth and stale position readings.
- Received axis data is no longer discarded on its way out of the parse loop.
- Soft limits and zone widths were being sent 57x too large, which left both end-stop bits set and the stage refusing to move.
- =? queries no longer overwrite the parameter they query. HLIM=? previously wrote HLIM=0.
- MIMP and the OFSA/OFSB offsets are now scaled correctly; MASS to CFRQ restored to its full six-step table.

Changed
- Axes are stored in a map keyed by axis letter, with resolution centralised in one method that errors rather than guessing when the axis is ambiguous.
- Amplitude and phase scale factors are derived on the diagram instead of appearing as unexplained constants.
- Settings file parser rewritten to handle comments and decimal values.

Removed
- The Controller.LV:receiveData override and its unbounded blocking wait, which could hang the process loop.
- Controller:setSpeed deprecated: it applies a position conversion to a speed.
item.dc:creator: Levylab

item.title: RemoteControl v1.4.2.21
item.description:
Product: RemoteControl v1.4.2.21
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 13:03:47 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Parent library for sending messages to programs occupying different application instances, ie, LabVIEW running on different computers, multiple instances of LabVIEW on a single computer, or compiled applications. By itself this library does not implement a specific or even working communication protocol, but provides abstract methods that can be overridden by, for example, ZMQ, MQTT, etc.

Release Notes: #2 eliminate variant to string to variant conversion when reading/receiving messages
